name: Butt kicks
cue: Jog on the spot, heels flick up to the glutes.

name: Jog on the spot
cue: Light run in place, easy pace, used for warm-ups and active rest.

name: Step jack
cue: Low-impact jumping jack: step one foot out at a time while the arms go overhead.

name: Cross jacks
cue: Jumping jack where feet and arms cross in front instead of landing wide.

name: In-and-out squat (squat jack / pop squat)
cue: Jump the feet wide into a squat, then jump back together; hands touch the floor on pop squats.

name: Skater jumps
cue: Leap sideways from one foot to the other, trailing leg sweeps behind, land soft.

name: Lateral hops (line jumps)
cue: Feet together, hop side to side over a line or object.

name: Lateral shuffle
cue: Low athletic stance, shuffle a few steps left then right without crossing the feet.

name: Fast feet
cue: Quarter squat, feet chop the floor as fast as possible.

name: Twist jumps
cue: Small jump, rotate hips one way and shoulders the other, feet together.

name: Heisman
cue: Shuffle sideways two steps and lift the outside knee, holding the pose like the trophy.

name: Front kicks
cue: Standing, kick one leg forward to hip height, alternate sides.

name: Shadow boxing punches
cue: Boxer stance, alternate straight punches or hooks, rotate the torso with each punch.

name: Knee drives
cue: From a split stance, drive the back knee up to the chest fast, reset and repeat.

name: Alternating toe taps
cue: Quick alternating taps of the toes to a spot or step in front of you.

name: Up-and-overs
cue: Step or hop sideways over an imaginary line, swinging the arms up and across.

name: Reverse lunge
cue: Step back into a lunge, front shin vertical, drive up through the front heel.

name: Lateral lunge (side lunge)
cue: Step wide to one side, sit into that hip with the other leg straight, push back to standing.

name: Curtsy lunge
cue: Step one leg behind and across the other, lower until the back knee nearly touches, stand.

name: Jumping lunges
cue: Lunge, jump and switch legs in the air, land soft in the opposite lunge.

name: Cossack squat
cue: Wide stance, sit fully into one leg with the other straight and toes up, shift across.

name: Kneel to stand
cue: From kneeling, step one foot forward and stand without using the hands, kneel back down.

name: Inchworm (walk-out)
cue: Fold and walk the hands out to a plank, then walk them back to the feet and stand.

name: Crab toe touch
cue: Reverse tabletop on hands and feet, kick one leg up and touch the toe with the opposite hand.

name: Leg swings
cue: Hold something for balance, swing one leg forward and back or across the body.

name: Standing leg circles
cue: Balance on one leg, draw circles with the other knee to open the hip.

name: Arm circles
cue: Arms straight out to the sides, small to large circles, forward then back.

name: Standing arm open and close
cue: Arms extended at shoulder height, open wide and squeeze closed in front, keep the shoulders down.

name: Overhead reach
cue: Reach both arms up and slightly back, alternate or together, to warm the shoulders.

name: Standing side reach
cue: Reach one arm overhead and bend to the opposite side, alternate.

name: Cross-body toe touch
cue: Standing, kick or raise one leg and touch it with the opposite hand.

name: Standing crunch (elbow to knee)
cue: Hands behind the head, lift a knee and bring the opposite elbow to it.

name: Dance cardio
cue: Follow the on-screen choreography for the whole song; keep moving, big arms, land soft.

name: Warm-up (follow the video)
cue: General warm-up segment; follow the instructor's moves.

name: Cool-down and stretch (follow the video)
cue: General cool-down segment; follow the instructor's stretches.

name: Up-down plank
cue: From a forearm plank push up one arm at a time to a high plank, lower back down, alternate the lead arm.

name: Plank jacks
cue: High plank, jump the feet wide and back together, hips level.

name: Plank hip dips
cue: Forearm plank, rotate the hips to tap one side to the floor, then the other.

name: Plank shoulder taps
cue: High plank, tap the opposite shoulder with one hand, keep the hips still.

name: Plank bunny hops
cue: High plank, hop both feet together side to side or forward and back.

name: Spider-Man plank
cue: High plank, bring one knee out to the same-side elbow, alternate.

name: Cross-body mountain climber
cue: High plank, drive each knee under the body to the opposite elbow, fast.

name: T rotation
cue: From a push-up position rotate to a side plank reaching the top arm to the ceiling, return, alternate.

name: Reverse plank
cue: Sit with legs long, hands behind, lift the hips until the body is a straight line.

name: Superman
cue: Lie face down, lift arms and legs together, squeeze the back and glutes.

name: Bicycle crunch
cue: On the back, hands behind the head, bring opposite elbow to knee as the other leg extends.

name: Russian twist
cue: Seated, lean back, feet up or down, rotate the torso side to side.

name: Heel touches
cue: On the back, knees bent, crunch sideways to tap each heel with the same-side hand.

name: Toe touch crunch
cue: On the back with legs straight up, crunch and reach the hands to the toes.

name: In-and-outs (seated knee tucks)
cue: Seated with hands beside the hips, extend the legs out then tuck the knees in.

name: Seated crunch (V-sit crunch)
cue: Seated with feet off the floor, lean back and crunch up, add a twist for obliques.

name: Jackknife (V-up)
cue: Lie flat, lift arms and legs together to touch the toes above the hips, lower slowly.

name: Starfish crunch
cue: Lie in a star shape, crunch up bringing one hand to the opposite foot, alternate.

name: Corkscrew
cue: On the back, legs together lifted, rotate the legs in a circle or side to side using the obliques.

name: The hundred
cue: Head and shoulders lifted, legs in tabletop or extended, pump the arms while breathing in fives.

name: Hollow hold (ab hold)
cue: On the back, lower back pressed down, shoulders and legs hovering, hold.

name: Dead bug
cue: On the back, arms up and knees over hips, extend opposite arm and leg, keep the lower back down.

name: Deep squat hold
cue: Sit into the lowest squat you can with heels down, elbows push the knees out.

name: Dumbbell sumo squat
cue: Wide stance, toes out, one dumbbell hanging between the legs, squat and drive the knees out.

name: Dumbbell lateral lunge
cue: Step wide, sit into one hip with dumbbells at the sides or chest, push back.

name: Dumbbell push press
cue: Dip the knees and drive the dumbbells overhead using the legs, lower under control.

name: Dumbbell skull crusher
cue: Lying, dumbbells over the chest, bend the elbows to lower beside the head, extend.

name: Dumbbell pullover
cue: Lying, dumbbell(s) over the chest, lower behind the head with soft elbows and pull back over.

name: Dumbbell upright row
cue: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, pull up to chest height leading with the elbows.

name: Renegade row
cue: High plank on the dumbbells, row one to the hip without twisting the hips, alternate.

name: Single-arm dumbbell swing
cue: Hinge and swing one dumbbell between the legs to chest height, hips snap, switch hands halfway.

name: Easy pose (Sukhasana)
cue: Sit cross-legged, spine tall, hands on the knees or at the heart; breathe.

name: Seated twist
cue: Seated, inhale to lengthen, exhale to rotate, one hand behind you and one on the knee.

name: Seated side body stretch
cue: One hand down, the other reaches up and over to open the side body, then switch.

name: Seated chest opener
cue: Fingertips behind you on the floor, lift the chest and draw the shoulders back.

name: Tabletop
cue: On hands and knees, wrists under shoulders, knees under hips, neutral spine.

name: Cat-cow
cue: From tabletop, inhale to drop the belly and lift the gaze, exhale to round the spine and tuck the chin.

name: Wrist circles
cue: From tabletop, roll the wrists and shake out the hands.

name: Thread the needle
cue: From tabletop slide one arm under the body, shoulder and ear to the mat, then switch sides.

name: Puppy pose (Anahatasana)
cue: From tabletop walk the hands forward, hips stay over the knees, chest melts toward the floor.

name: Downward-facing dog
cue: Hands and feet on the mat, hips high, long spine, heels reaching toward the floor.

name: Standing forward fold (Uttanasana)
cue: Feet hip-width, fold from the hips with soft knees, let the head hang.

name: Mountain pose (Tadasana)
cue: Stand tall, feet grounded, shoulders relaxed, breathe.

name: Upward salute / volcano pose
cue: From mountain, reach both arms up overhead, lift through the chest.

name: Low lunge (runner's lunge)
cue: Front knee over the ankle, back knee down or lifted, hips sink forward.

name: Warrior I
cue: Long stance, back foot turned in, front knee bent, arms reach overhead.

name: Warrior II
cue: Wide stance, front knee bent over the ankle, arms out in a line, gaze over the front hand.

name: Sphinx pose
cue: Lie on the belly, forearms down with elbows under the shoulders, lift the chest.

name: Cobra pose
cue: Lie on the belly, hands under the shoulders, peel the chest up with light hands.

name: Child's pose (Balasana)
cue: Knees wide or together, hips to the heels, forehead down, arms long or by the sides.

name: Shark fin
cue: Sit on the heels or kneel, one arm bends so the hand is behind the head like a fin, lean and breathe, switch sides.

name: Boat pose (Navasana)
cue: Seated, lean back and lift the shins parallel to the floor (half boat) or straighten the legs.

name: Savasana (corpse pose)
cue: Lie flat on the back, arms by the sides, palms up, relax completely.
